document.abstract: A magnetic track deposited between the sprocket holes and the edge of 8-mm film gives good-quality sound which can be added to any ordinary 8-mm film. Modifications of standard projectors for using this system are described. Performances for speeds of 16, 18, and 24 frames per second are given.
